# QuotaPin 1.3.0

This stable release keeps the v1.2 account-row interface and promotes only the beta work that has an independent, bounded contract.

Windows package: `QuotaPin-1.3.0.exe`

macOS package: `QuotaPin-macOS-1.3.0.dmg`

Windows 10 version 2004 or later is supported on x64. Windows 11 ARM64 runs the same x64 package through native emulation and is accepted by the release gate.

- Add optional account-wide burn pace and estimated runway modules. They use only official remaining-percentage history, wait for enough evidence, reset calibration at quota renewal, and keep uncertainty in hover instead of widening the row.
- Keep compact and localized time modules aligned to absolute timestamps, including live runway boundaries, so delayed renderer work cannot accumulate clock drift.
- Make built-in hover details more useful with localized reset context, forecast detail when available, and exact token totals from their existing sources.
- Keep stable update discovery stable-only. Betas remain exact-version installs and never enter the normal update picker.
- Preserve startup ownership across the verified Windows installer handoff so a failed replacement cannot silently disable automatic attachment.
- Require install, execution, and uninstall acceptance of the x64 Windows package on a native Windows 11 ARM64 runner before publication.

The 2.x multi-position interface remains a prerelease experiment and is not enabled by this stable release.

Windows Quick Start:

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WSL043/QuotaPin-for-Codex/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

macOS Quick Start:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WSL043/QuotaPin-for-Codex/main/install-macos.sh | bash
```
